meta.description: Build and deploy applications on inference.sh. Use when getting started, understanding the platform, creating apps, configuring resources, or needing an overview of inference.sh app development. Supports both Python and Node.js. howto.what_en: Claude guides you to create, test, and deploy inference.sh apps using the belt CLI, supporting Python and Node.js. It auto-generates project structure to avoid manual configuration errors.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention inference.sh app, belt app, inf.yml, deploy app, GPU app, VRAM, or ask about getting started, creating apps, configuring resources.

say_en.text: Create a Python app named my-app using belt app init.
say_en.note: Claude runs the command and generates the project skeleton.

say_en.text: How do I configure GPU with 24GB VRAM for my app?
say_en.note: Claude guides you to edit the resources section in inf.yml.

say_en.text: Deploy my app and verify output_meta is returned.
say_en.note: Claude runs belt app deploy and belt app run commands.
